body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 1-unit burst within weapon range. Compare this Action against each enemy in the burst. On a success, that enemy suffers -1 Defense until the start of its next turn.

surges.html: Choose one creature this Action succeeds against. After this resolves, you may make a Basic Shot against it by committing that Basic Shot's dice normally.
Objects and cover affected by this Action count their Defense as 1 lower.

rider.title: SUPPRESSION
rider.html: If your Locked target is inside the affected area, the area remains threatened until your next turn; the first enemy that enters it burns 1 die.
